UTF-8 verification tests for single glyphs, combined glyphs, and out-of-bounds reads.

# Purpose
This file is a C test program for `fd_utf8_verify` in `fd_utf8.h`. It defines a set of UTF-8 test vectors for valid and invalid single glyphs, then checks that the verifier returns the expected result for each case, including shorter lengths and inputs with inserted `'\0'` bytes. It also tests pairs of glyphs, scans all byte values to help detect out-of-bounds reads, and includes explicit cases for embedded null bytes and truncated multibyte sequences. The program ends by logging `pass` and stopping with `fd_halt()`.
